```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
data = {"name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"], "spend": [500, 1200, 999, 1500]}
df_pd = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Wrap with narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)

# Add tier column using backend-evaluated conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

# Display result
print(df.to_native())
```
